reviews.text: The problem is the salon is too small for the number of people, and the decor is outdated; the work is still very old-fashioned. Otherwise, it's very nice. If the salon were modernized, it could be a good one.
Thank you so much for your feedback! We're delighted you enjoyed your experience. We look forward to welcoming you back!

We've been coming here regularly for two years now, and it's always a real joy to be able to leave my little baby in the hands of people who truly care for her and with whom I know she's safe. I found it particularly sweet that they even encouraged her in English, her native language! It's a small gesture that touched me deeply and shows how caring and attentive the team is to each animal. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for somewhere they can leave their pet with complete peace of mind.

I am very disappointed. For two years I took my cocker spaniel to the groomer every month. The last time, he was there for three and a half hours, and my dog ​​wasn't even washed—just a dry shampoo. The inside of his ears was black and smelled bad. His haircut was a mess, full of gaps, and one side didn't even look the same! Extremely unhappy, I found another groomer who told me my cocker had been shaved! This is unacceptable because I have always stated that I didn't want him shaved. I came to your salon to see a manager, but since the manager wasn't there, I had to speak to a student to express my dissatisfaction. She told me she would pass it on to her supervisor. Three weeks have passed, and I haven't heard anything back! This is truly unacceptable.

I am very disappointed with this grooming. My cat, Nash, is a regular at this salon, and this is the first time I've picked him up shaved so short, over such a large area of ​​his body. I am genuinely shocked by the result.

I entrusted him to professionals so that a suitable solution could be found for his matting. I wasn't clearly informed that an almost complete shave would be performed, so my consent couldn't be fully informed. If such a drastic procedure seemed necessary, I would have appreciated being contacted beforehand so that the situation could be explained to me precisely and my authorization obtained.
I was told that he was panting and growling. In that case, it might have been better to pause, adjust the method, or contact me, rather than proceeding with such a significant shave in just thirty minutes, with three people doing it.
I will now have to carefully monitor his skin to check for any irritation or cuts. This is absolutely not the result I expected from a trade show.

We had been loyal customers for two to three years and were always very satisfied with our dog's grooming. The team was always friendly and professional, which naturally led us to return regularly.

However, this is the second time our dog has been completely shaved when we simply asked for her fur to be trimmed. We acknowledge that in the past, a shave was necessary due to significant matting, BUT this time, we were very careful: she didn't have any matting that would have warranted a complete shave.

The result is not what we requested, and it's a real disappointment, as we had trusted them for a long time.

We hope this feedback will be helpful in preventing this from happening again.

I brought my toy poodle in for a wash and trim, and I loved the result. Plus, the staff seemed lovely.
I highly recommend it!

I spent two half-days learning how to groom my English Cocker Spaniel. The training went wonderfully: I learned all the basics of grooming thanks to Parvine's guidance. She was gentle, kind, and attentive. We went at my pace. I loved it! I 100% recommend the training courses at Audreco. Thank you again for everything!

I brought my rabbit in for his first grooming session because he doesn't like being brushed. I'm so glad I went to this salon; the team was friendly and incredibly gentle. They knew how to relax my stressed rabbit and left him looking impeccable.
In just 30 minutes, I saw a dramatic improvement in his fur and overall cleanliness. I have an appointment for my cat next week and I'll definitely go back. The prices are very reasonable for the service provided.
